label: Bible Study
prompt: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the _____ of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
verse: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
note: Nations streaming to God's mountain to learn his ways — Isaiah 2 has nearly the same words.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their _____.
verse: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
note: Rain in due season and trees yielding fruit — God's farm report for a faithful people.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said unto them, Take me up, and _____ me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
verse: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
note: Jonah's own solution to the storm: throw me overboard — and the sea will calm down.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but _____ the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
verse: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
note: John's spirit check: don't believe every voice — the next verse gives the test, confessing Christ come in the flesh.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a _____ people:
verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
note: After the golden calf, God's verdict on Israel: 'a stiffnecked people' — like oxen refusing to bow to the yoke.
